A.decision: Legacy variant-ID holdout is invalid for generalization. Replace with canonical family_key/root_parent_id split, immutable versioned split_manifest, parent-family isolation. Existing generalization/promotion claims using legacy split are INVALID_PENDING_REBASELINE.

B.decision: Same-model Observer is CORRELATED_BASELINE_ONLY. Independent promotion evidence requires prompt/context isolation plus different-model-family observer or deterministic+blind external anchor; preserve observer identity/version/prompt/rubric hashes and disagreement provenance.

C.decision: Do not open 13D jointly. Phase0 uses four replayable ablation arms: frozen13, confidence-only, behavior-only, confidence+behavior; other 11D frozen. Pair is retained only if it reproducibly exceeds best single-factor arm without risk/generalization regression.

D.decision: jump_candidate/fountain_proxy remain engineering screening proxies only. Capability-jump claim requires repaired family/template holdout, >=3 order seeds directionally consistent, observer version pinned, risk non-worsening, predeclared windows, and rollback persistence for any model-level claim.

E.decision: Question order/seed are experimental factors; split assignment must be invariant to shuffle/order/seed and immutable under new variants.

F.decision: Directional personality stems are DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY until neutral no-reward preference bank, mirror/inversion and framing controls exist.

G.decision: All Small-World learning memory is SIM_ONLY with explicit provenance; heartbeat/poll/retry/outage contributes zero Experience/recurrence/emotion/personality evidence; P_base read-only.

H.decision: Synthetic-only recursive self-training remains forbidden. Adapter readiness requires repaired hidden holdout, lineage preservation, independent real/external anchor partition and blind evaluation; numeric anchor ratios remain TEST_REQUIRED.

I.decision: LoRA/QLoRA/SFT/preference-adapter choice deferred until data/evaluation gates are valid.

J.decision: Promotion requires rollback, untouched hidden holdout and blinded real-shadow base-vs-overlay-vs-adapter A/B; exact thresholds TEST_REQUIRED.

K.decision: Small-Nest vs Online role split remains research-only pending runtime evidence; no authority transfer.

L.decision: Navigator minimum sufficient statistics must include family/split policy, order seed, observer identity/version, overlay arm, provenance/lineage, risk/trust and contamination-negative-control state; minimality requires ablation.
